test_title: SSC CHSL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follows from the statements.

**Statements:**

(A) All actors are gold.

(B) All gold are houses.

(C) All rooms are houses.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some gold are rooms.

II. Some rooms are actors.

options.text: Neither Conclusion I nor Conclusion II follows
Both Conclusion I and Conclusion II follow

solution:
The least possible venn diagram is shown below,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/200e3a48886985288093cad483a9df3ac3379b5b79a4f9f6726d2ad7aea36b06.png] 

Conclusion I: **False** (Because there is no direct relation given between Gold and Rooms).

Conclusion II: **False** (Because there is no direct relation given between Rooms and Actors).

Hence, the correct answer is **"Neither Conclusion I nor Conclusion II follows"**.
